title: Faithfulness: fix a rigorous construction of $\mu$ / construction-independence

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
**Sub-lemma (GAP 5) — faithfulness.** The problem does not pin down a construction of the $\Phi^4_3$ measure $\mu$. A complete proof must either (i) fix one explicit rigorous construction (e.g. the invariant measure of the renormalized $\Phi^4_3$ dynamics via regularity structures / paracontrolled calculus, or the Barashkov–Gubinelli variational measure) and state its support ($C^{-1/2-\kappa}(\mathbb{T}^3)$), Cameron–Martin space ($H^1$), and renormalization constants; or (ii) prove the equivalence statement is independent of the (mutually equivalent) constructions.

**Why it matters.** All later steps (Wick powers, counterterms, tail estimates, Girsanov drift) depend on the precise definition. Silently switching between constructions mid-proof is a definitional-drift failure. Also confirm the elementary point that smooth $\psi\not\equiv0$ lies in the Cameron–Martin space $H^1(\mathbb{T}^3)$ so the Gaussian exponent $\langle\psi,u\rangle_{CM}-\tfrac12\|\psi\|_{CM}^2$ is finite and nondegenerate — and as a sanity check that at $\lambda=0$ the density reduces exactly to the GFF Cameron–Martin density.
